source.title: Diagnose and fix ChatGPT Desktop memory crash via RDC
source.objective: Investigate the ChatGPT Desktop crash during the night of 2026-09-25 to 2026-09-26 (Europe/Copenhagen) that was associated with excessive memory use. Use Remote Desktop Commander on Fedora to establish the root cause from system/app evidence, then apply the smallest safe local fix or mitigation if the evidence supports one.
source.acceptance_json: ["Identify the incident window and the exact process/subprocess termination path using Fedora journal, kernel/systemd-oomd OOM evidence, coredump/app logs, and available ChatGPT Desktop diagnostics.", "Quantify relevant RAM, swap and ChatGPT Desktop subprocess memory behavior well enough to distinguish an application/process leak or runaway workload from general system memory pressure.", "Document the evidence-backed root cause or, if it cannot be proven, the narrowest remaining hypotheses and what evidence is missing; do not guess.", "If a safe local fix or mitigation is supported by the evidence, implement it through RDC with minimal scope and a reversible change path.", "Run targeted post-change validation through RDC and record evidence that ChatGPT Desktop launches and operates without immediately reproducing the abnormal memory behavior or OOM path.", "If the root cause is upstream or cannot be fixed locally, leave a durable C2 checkpoint with evidence, practical containment/monitoring, and one precise next action."]
source.next_action: Correlate Fedora journal/OOM/monitor telemetry for incident window before choosing a bounded fix.
source.blocker: Requires the designated human/RDC incident investigation; no deterministic C2 execution context is registered.
